Title: LiteLLM vulnerable to reflected XSS in /sso/debug/callback
Description: The `/sso/debug/callback` endpoint reflected identity-provider-controlled fields into an inline `<script>` block via `json.dumps`, which escapes JSON string syntax but not HTML context characters such as `</script>`. An IdP-returned string field containing `</script>` (for example a user-editable display name) closed the script block and executed attacker JavaScript in the proxy's origin.
NotImpacted: All versions before 1.65.5, all versions starting from 1.85.0
